Chairman of the Executive Board{{cite web| url=https://www.boschrexroth.com/en/dc/company/executive-board/| title=Executive Board {{!}} Bosch Rexroth AG| accessdate=2023-02-13}} | industry = Mobile applications, machinery applications and engineering, factory automation | products = Hydraulics, Electric Drives & Controls, Tightening Systems, Linear Motion, Assembly Technologies | revenue = €6.2 billion (2021) {{cite web| url=https://www.boschrexroth.com/en/dc/company/figures/| title=Figures {{!}} Bosch Rexroth AG| accessdate=2023-02-13}} | num_employees = 31,100 (2021) {{cite web| url=https://www.boschrexroth.com/en/dc/company/figures/| title=Figures {{!}} Bosch Rexroth AG| accessdate=2023-02-13}} | parent = [[Bosch (company)|Robert Bosch GmbH]] | website = {{url | https://www.boschrexroth.com/en/dc/|boschrexroth.com}} }} '''Bosch Rexroth AG''' is an engineering firm based in [[Lohr am Main]] in [[Germany]]. It is the result of a [[Mergers and acquisitions|merger]] on 1 May 2001, between [[Mannesmann]] Rexroth AG and the Automation Technology Business Unit of [[Bosch (company)|Robert Bosch GmbH]], and is a wholly owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH.{{cite web | url=https://www.boschrexroth.com/en/dc/company/our-history/|title=Our History {{!}} Bosch Rexroth AG|accessdate=2023-02-13}} Bosch Rexroth employs over 31,000 people worldwide, and achieved total revenue of 6.2 billion euro in 2021. In 2011 Bosch Rexroth acquired the hydraulic motor business formerly owned by [[Hägglund & Söner]]. The company maintains a manufacturing base in the Swedish town of [[Örnsköldsvik]] that was the home of Hägglund & Söner, and still manufactures products using the Hägglunds brand.{{cite web [[File:Elmomc-logo-dark.webp|Elmomc-logo-dark]] | type = [[Privately held company|Private]] | industry = [[Motion control]] | founded = 1988 | founder = Haim Monhait | hq_location = [[Petah Tikva]], Israel | key_people = [https://www.inddist.com/staffing-changes/news/22873603/bosch-rexroth-names-new-ceo-of-elmo-motion-control Ronen Boneh] (CEO) | products = * Servo Drives (single & multi-axes) * Motion Controllers * Integrated Drives & Motors * Power Supplies | num_employees = 400 | parent = [[Bosch Rexroth]] | website = [https://www.elmomc.com www.elmomc.com] }} '''Elmo Motion Control''' is an engineering company specializing in developing, producing, and selling hardware and software in [[motion control]]. The company wis based in Petah Tikva, Israel. On September 4, 2022, Elmo was fully acquired by Bosch Rexroth.{{Cite web |date=2022-09-05 |title=Bosch to acquire Elmo Motion Control for $700 million |url=https://www.calcalistech.com/ctechnews/article/s16nrsxgs |access-date=2024-07-08 |website=ctech |language=en}} Elmo Motion Control was established in 1988 by Haim Monhait. Four years later, in 1992, the company expanded its operations by opening its first subsidiary in the United States. In 2008, Elmo acquired and merged with Control Solutions (Pitronot Bakara). In 2015, the company opened an additional production facility in [[Warsaw]], Poland, to meet the growing demand. Over the years, Elmo expanded its global presence by establishing eight additional subsidiaries worldwide. These include operations in China, Europe, and the APAC region. The most recent subsidiary was opened in Singapore in 2019. Elmo employs over 400 personnel and has its headquarters and manufacturing facilities in [[Petah Tikva]], [[Israel]]. The company also has worldwide sales and technical support offices and additional manufacturing facilities. Elmo's products cater to various industries, such as semiconductors, lasers, robots, drones, life sciences, [[industrial automation]], and extreme environments.{{Cite news |last= |first= |date=2013-08-14 |title=Elmo Motion Control Introduces Ultra-High Current Military Servo Drives |url=https://www.automate.org/motion-control/news/elmo-motion-control-introduces-ultra-high-current-military-servo-drives |work=Association for Advancing Automation (A3)}} Elmo Motion Control provides various [[servo drive]]s suitable for various motion requirements, from industrial applications that require high precision and power density to extreme applications designed for harsh environments. Since its establishment, Elmo has developed three generations of products, each offering servo drives and motion controllers for both industrial and harsh environments. Platinum's latest product{{Cite news |last= |first= |date=2013-11-13 |title=Elmo Motion Control Announces New Solutions at SPS Germany 2023 |url=https://www.novuslight.com/elmo-motion-control-announces-new-solutions-at-sps-germany-2023_N13008.html}} line is touted for its [[EtherCAT]] networking precision. ==References== {{Reflist|30em}} == External links == {{commons category}} *{{official website}} * [https://www.elmomc.com Elmo Motion Control] {{Bosch}} {{Authority control}} [[Category:Engineering companies of Germany]] [[Category:Companies based in Bavaria]] [[Category:German companies established in 1795]] [[Category:Manufacturing companies established in 1795]] [[Category:German brands]] [[Category:Manufacturing companies of Germany]] [[Category:Bosch (company)]] [[Category:Bearing manufacturers]] [[Category:Pump manufacturers]]
